command: set -euo pipefail; test -f /tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-pre-update-old.apk; test -f /tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-pre-update-data.tar; test -f /tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-db8c3ce.apk; test "$(shasum -a 256 /tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-pre-update-data.tar | awk '{print $1}')" = '2dadcc5a56f23adaa99e23655bc101f9261a5f0fa659f01d04c1aa4f05b42582'; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test -n "$SERIAL"; adb -s "$SERIAL" uninstall io.blueeye; adb -s "$SERIAL" install /tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-db8c3ce.apk; cat /tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-pre-update-data.tar | adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye sh -c 'cd /data/user/0/io.blueeye && tar xf -'; for P in android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS; do adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm grant io.blueeye "$P" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo RESTORED_FILES; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye ls -l databases; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n io.blueeye/.MainActivity; sleep 3; P=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path io.blueeye | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's/^package://p' | head -n1); TMP=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$P" "$TMP" >/dev/null; HASH=$(shasum -a 256 "$TMP" | awk '{print $1}'); echo installed_sha=$HASH; test "$HASH" = '4d4a58789fb94d5e984d2135c2942018f4d8ae0cfb06d6f49692a0a454941ace'; SNAP=$(mktemp); adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye sh -c 'cd /data/user/0/io.blueeye && tar cf - databases' > "$SNAP"; D=$(mktemp -d); tar xf "$SNAP" -C "$D"; sqlite3 "$D/databases/tracker_database" 'PRAGMA integrity_check; select count(*) from devices; select count(*) from signal_samples; select count(*) from follow_me_observations;'; rm -f "$SNAP"; rm -rf "$D"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye; echo SIGNATURE_MIGRATION_PASS
